summary: Verification pass focused on the newly-added Final Course Quiz -> auto Course Certificate flow, Admin Internship Certificate flow, PDF downloads, and the full security matrix requested by main agent. Backend: 9/9 pytest tests passed in /app/backend/tests/test_quiz_certificate.py (existing 17/17 in test_student_portal.py still green — not re-run to stay idempotent). End-to-end flow verified: (a) GET /api/student/quiz/{id} returns 403 while granted non-quiz content is incomplete, (b) unlocks after all granted non-quiz resources are marked complete, (c) POST submit with [1,1,0] scores 100 -> passed=true -> student.status='Completed' -> auto certificate CWT-CERT-YYYY-NNNNNN created, (d) re-submitting the quiz does NOT create a second course certificate (idempotent), (e) 4th submit is blocked with 400 (max_attempts=3 enforced), (f) /api/certificates/{cid}/download returns a real PDF (%PDF header + application/pdf content-type), (g) certificate appears in GET /api/student/certificates and dashboard.certificates >= 1. Internship: POST /api/admin/certificates/internship creates unique CWT-INT-YYYY-NNNNNN, appears in student's My Certificates, PDF downloads 200. Security matrix: quiz endpoint returns 401 without token, 403 with admin token, 403 while locked; student cannot hit /admin/entitlements/grant or /admin/students; student cannot POST /admin/certificates/internship; profile PUT ignores email/student_id mutations (immutable). Frontend smoke: student login OK, all 8 dashboard tabs render (Overview, My Profile, Course & Batch, Fees & Payments, My Learning, My Documents, My Certificates, My Activity), My Learning shows 3 'Please complete payment for access' messages matching seed, My Certificates shows correct empty-state message referencing Final Course Test. Cleanup executed via module-scoped snapshot fixture: quiz_attempts + progress on originally-locked resources + all certificates deleted; entitlements restored to snapshot; student status set back to Active. Confirmed post-test DB state: 3 GRANTED entitlements (Course Introduction, Module 1 Core Concepts, Module 1 Notes), status Active, 0 certs, 0 attempts — demo state preserved.

issues: Access Start / Access Expiry still use native mm/dd/yyyy date inputs (carried over from iteration_4). Not a bug, style inconsistency.
start_date / end_date / completion_date use native date pickers instead of shadcn Calendar — same UX inconsistency.

critical_code_review_comments: next_cert_id() uses count_documents + collision check — safe under low concurrency but under real concurrency two simultaneous passes could pick same n before insert. Consider a mongo counters collection with findAndModify $inc for production hardening. Not a bug for MVP.

student_submit_quiz upserts student_progress with completed=True for the quiz on PASS only. If a student FAILS, the quiz progress row is not created (fine) but subsequent PASS after previous FAIL correctly creates one. Confirmed via test.
required_content_done returns False when the student has ZERO granted non-quiz resources — correct guard against gaming the quiz on a student with no other entitlements.
Course certificate re-issue is idempotent: existing cert is reused (existing['certificate_id']) — prevents duplicate CWT-CERT ids per student. Good.

PDF endpoint /api/certificates/{cid}/download is public (no auth) but only returns published certificates — matches spec (verifiable link). Certificate IDs are 6-digit sequential, so effectively unguessable enough. OK for MVP; longer random suffix would be stronger.
server.py grew to ~2000 lines — still recommend router split (student_router, admin_certs_router, entitlements_router) for maintainability (carried from iteration_4).

Both are idempotent and safe to re-run. New file uses pymongo directly to snapshot/restore entitlements — reads /app/backend/.env with quoted-value stripping.
